test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the Indian Executive who has been chosen for the Prestigious USIBC Global Leadership Award 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is__** N Chandrasekaran.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **N Chandrasekaran**

 
 
• ​Natarajan Chandrasekaran is** chairman of Tata Sons.**
 
• He was **Chief operating officer** **(COO) **and **executive director** of Tata Consultancy Services **(TCS).**
 
• In **2009**, he became **Chief executive officer (CEO).**
 
• He was also the chairman of **Tata Motors** and **Tata Global Beverages (TGB).**
 
• He became the first non-Parsi and professional executive to head the Tata Group.
 
• He has been chosen for the **Prestigious USIBC Global Leadership Award 2020.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **USIBC Global Leadership Award**

 
 
• **The USIBC Global Leadership Award has been presented annually since 2007.**
 
• It is accorded to the top corporate executives from the United States and India.
 
• It is accorded whose companies play a major role in promoting growth in the US-India commercial corridor.
 
• It is a recognition for their outstanding leadership and for promoting Indo-US trade and business.
